_comment_finding: Finding #03: unsafe-inline Scripts on OAuth, Brief, and Sandbox Routes
_comment_what_was_wrong: Route-specific CSP overrides for /api/slack/oauth/callback, /api/discord/oauth/callback, /api/brief/(.*), and /wm-widget-sandbox.html included script-src 'unsafe-inline', weakening injection protection on callback and preview surfaces.
_comment_what_this_fix_does: Replaces 'unsafe-inline' on OAuth callbacks, brief endpoints, and widget sandbox routes with 'self' (or cryptographic sha256 hashes for legitimate static inline bootstrap snippets).

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https:; frame-ancestors 'none';
default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://api.worldmonitor.app; img-src 'self' data: https:; frame-ancestors 'self';
